thread:
anya (prod): quick design review: thinking about adding a single-line "connectivity score" for the network step (0-100) so users get an at-a-glance sense before expanding details. does this feel useful or misleading?
tom (design): i like the idea for the top-level summary, but worried about oversimplifying. maybe show score + a small qualifier (e.g., "Partial" / "Full") and keep the per-probe breakdown collapsed underneath. visual: small horizontal bar with color stops and numeric value.
rahul (eng): backend-wise we can compute a simple weighted score from probe results. caveat: some failures are cosmetic (missing reverse DNS) and shouldn't tank the score. we should let the config indicate weight per probe. also we need to avoid re-running probes on every page load 10x spammers. cache last result for N minutes.
sophia (a11y): accessibility concerns: numeric score alone is ambiguous for screen reader users. recommend text fallback: "Connectivity health: 72 out of 100 (Partial)" and an aria-describedby to the expand button that links to the probe list. aria-live: use polite for score updates, but debounce updates >1s to avoid noisy announcements.
tom (design): good call. UX tweak: when the score is low show an inline CTA "Try quick fixes" that opens a micro panel with 1-2 actionable steps (open port, add CIDR). if the user wants deep logs they can "View full report".
rahul (eng): implementation note: micro panel should be client-side and contain copy-only commands/snippets. we'll fetch URLs for deep KB only if user opts in (`docs_fetch_enabled`). for private deployments default false.
anya (prod): copy tone: change from "probe failed" -> "Connectivity issue detected" and from "ok" -> "Connectivity good". less technical jargon for product users.
tom (design): also avoid alarmist colors for medium states. use amber for partial; red only for critical unreachable. ensure color + icon (check / exclamation / x) so color-blind users aren't left out.
sophia (a11y): confirm icons have descriptive alt text and we place text labels next to them at small sizes. for the expand control use "View details" label (verb + object). ensure keyboard focus lands on the first probe when panel opens.
rahul (eng): probe fetch strategy: store lastResult and lastCheckedAt in localStorage. if lastCheckedAt < 5m show cached value with a small faint "Stale" indicator and a prominent "Run checks" button. also add an exponential backoff on auto-runs to avoid hitting corporate firewalls repeatedly.
anya (prod): UX question: should we auto-run checks on initial load or require users to click "Run checks"? my vote: auto-run once if cache is older than 5m, otherwise show cached with "Run checks" CTA.
tom (design): auto-run one time is reasonable, but show micro-animation only in the pill (spinner) and avoid animating the whole row. for performance, place spinner inside the score bar so changes feel contained.
sophia (a11y): micro-animation accessibility: allow users to disable motion via prefers-reduced-motion and provide static spinner fallback. screen readers should announce "Running connectivity checks" once, not continuously. set aria-live=polite and only update on state changes.
rahul (eng): remediation UX: inline "Fix" link will open a small flyout with exact commands. we'll log user clicks for analytics but keep content copy-only. flyout will have a "Copy" button (aria-label="Copy snippet").
anya (prod): also add a small non-blocking banner if KB fetch fails: "Troubleshooting docs couldn't be loaded (offline)." put a tiny help icon linking to offline bundle if available.
tom (design): color contrast: current red for unreachable fails contrast at 12px. propose darker red (#b71c1c) or swap to a pill with white text on dark bg. also test in dark mode.
sophia (a11y): agreed on contrast. additionally, don't rely on color alone: status text + icon + aria-label. ensure focus outline is visible in all themes.
kb-bot: KB fetch attempt failed: 502 when contacting docs.redwood.ai/troubleshooting.
rahul (eng): noted. will implement graceful fallback UI and the `docs_fetch_enabled` flag. default: true for hosted, false for private installs. will also add telemetry opt-out boolean for docs fetch.
anya (prod): owners: tom -> visual + copy, sophia -> a11y sign-off, rahul -> implementation + local cache. target: prepare Figma comps + acceptance criteria for sprint planning. anyone else?
sophia (a11y): one more microcopy nit: change "Run checks" -> "Run connectivity checks" to be explicit for screen readers.
tom (design): updated label in Figma. uploading link in ~3h.
anya (prod): thanks team! closing thread. :v:"
